propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit one deterministic signed pin for each direct child and prerequisite with the canonical ticket ID and 16-hex material fingerprint

PlanRelationSnapshot must preload all ticket states store-wide including archived, scan both outgoing depends_on and inbound blocks, and produce deterministic related_material before any LLM evaluation
tracker_head_sha must verify the tickets-tracker is clean via git status/ls-files and return the 40-hex HEAD SHA, raising store-read-failure on any git/IO/path/subprocess error
Every unreadable or unresolvable target must return unsigned INDETERMINATE with exact structured ERROR before any LLM call rather than partial pins or traceback fallback
Manifest pins must preserve exact byte compatibility for legacy readers and collapse duplicate edges within each role while maintaining both prerequisite directions under the prerequisite role
